diagnosis: instructions_retired (1.95x) and cpu_cycles (2.19x) are roughly doubled while I-cache misses are 9.3x, so the kernel pays for a longer code path and poor locality from un-inlined helpers.
expected_effect: Inlining tightens the loop body (fewer I-cache misses), while local-cse + peephole remove repeated address/index computation, lowering instructions_retired and cycles.
